blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will get more relief from rising costs, as oil firms are expected to implement another round of price rollbacks amid an improving fuel supply outlook. In an advisory on Friday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said diesel prices and gasoline prices could drop by P3 to P3.50 per liter.
